rails_api.get: https://tokenizedblock.space/api/rails/plan?de=<token address or ETH>&vers=<token address or ETH>&montant=<integer, raw units of the token paid>&compte=<the wallet that will sign>
rails_api.returns: unsigned calls from the app's own planners (same fee guards); sign aSigner in order. The server signs and sends nothing.

etat.APPROBATIONS: sign the approvals, then ask for the plan again to get the swap
etat.REFUSE: refused — the reason is in pourquoi
etat.NON_MESURE: the chain could not be read — retry

rails_api.routes: block against its own quote token (ETH, USDC, OUSD or a tokenized stock); USDC or OUSD to a block quoted in ETH or USDC; block to block; block to a tokenized stock; ETH or USDC to a tokenized stock with a measured Aerodrome pool (12) or a read v4 USDC pool (20 more); such a stock back to USDC
rails_api.budget: 4 plans/min per IP, 20/min in total, 2 at a time; 429 + retry-after over that
rails_api.fee: the API is free; the fee is the one inside the transaction, paid only when your wallet executes it
rails_api.server_side_strictness: the server does not read input USD prices; it takes a fee only in USDC or in one of the 12 tokenized stocks with a measured deep Aerodrome pool: it may refuse a route the app accepts, never the reverse
rails_api.third_party_memestocks: a block quoted in a Coinbase tokenized stock on another launcher's hook trades here with a 0.5% fee taken in that stock, once per swap (proved on a Base fork: SI/NVDAc buy and sell)
rails_api.third_party_blocks: since 2026-10-03 (R10): any B20 absent from all our own records (router index, our blocks, our hooks), with those records read, is a third-party token: it trades on its own pool and hook with our 0.5% in the quote token (ETH, USDC, OUSD, cbBTC, TOSHI or a Coinbase stock); proved on a Base fork for SI/NVDAc, COBALT/USDC, FIRSTOUSD/OUSD, COFFR/ETH

mcp.transport: JSON-RPC 2.0, streamable HTTP without sessions, one request per POST (no event stream, no batch)
mcp.read_only: every tool returns unsigned calls; the user's wallet signs them in order. The server signs, holds and sends nothing.

birth.get: https://tokenizedblock.space/api/naissance/plan?nom=<block name>&symbole=<ticker>&compte=<the wallet that will sign>[&paire=<ETH or a currency address>][&sel=<free text that fixes the address>]
birth.fee: 0.001 ETH (0.0007 at creation + 0.0003 at registration); the plan is refused if the calls do not add up to exactly that
birth.creator_minimum: about $1 of the paired currency, never under the contract floor: a deposit, not a fee; it earns 0.03% of each trade; exit = a request (the share stops at once), then the withdrawal 7 days later
birth.proof: executed on a Base fork against the deployed hook: the returned calls sent as-is, all status 1, fee wallet +0.001 ETH, then the creator minimum requested and withdrawn in full after 7 days
birth.limit: a block made straight through the Base B20 factory does not pass through TokenizedBlock
